---
title: "open2"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = ">"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(saferGraph)
```
<br>

### Argument pdf
```{r}
open2(pdf = TRUE, pdf_name = "safer1") # pdf_name also present to avoid potential error messages
```
<br>

### Argument pdf_path
```{r}
open2(pdf_path = ".", pdf_name = "safer2")
```
<br>

### Argument pdf_name
```{r}
open2(pdf_name = "safer3")
```
<br>

### Argument width
```{r}
open2(width = 10, pdf_name = "safer4")
```
<br>

### Argument height
```{r}
open2(height = 8, pdf_name = "safer5")
```
<br>

### Argument paper
```{r}
open2(paper = "a4", pdf_name = "safer6")
open2(paper = "special", pdf_name = "safer7")
```
<br>

### Argument pdf_overwrite
```{r}
open2(pdf_overwrite = TRUE) # no need of pdf_name here because the plot is overwritten
```
<br>

### Argument rescale
```{r}
open2(rescale = "fit", pdf_name = "safer8")
open2(rescale = "fixed", pdf_name = "safer9")
```
<br>

### Argument remove_read_only
```{r}
open2(remove_read_only = FALSE, pdf_name = "safer10")
open2(remove_read_only = TRUE, pdf_name = "safer11")
```
<br>

### Argument return_output
```{r}
open2(return_output = TRUE, pdf_name = "safer12")
open2(return_output = FALSE, pdf_name = "safer13")
```
<br>

### Argument safer_check
```{r}
open2(safer_check = TRUE, pdf_name = "safer15")
```
<br>

### All the arguments
```{r}
open2(
  pdf = TRUE, 
  pdf_path = ".", 
  pdf_name = "name1", 
  width = 10, 
  height = 8, 
  paper = "a4", 
  pdf_overwrite = TRUE, 
  rescale = "fit", 
  remove_read_only = TRUE, 
  return_output = FALSE,
  safer_check = TRUE
)
```
<br>
